newsitem.title: THAILAND: Advance Agro to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Advance Agro to issue new shares.

text.p: Thai paper and pulp producer, Advance Agro said on Wednesday it would issue 104 million new shares at 10 baht each as part of an exercise to raise registered capital to five billion baht ($192 million).

Of the new shares, 69 million shares will be sold to existing shareholders through the rights issue in accordance with their holding proportion, Advance Agro said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The remaining 35 million shares will be offered to institutional investors through private placement, the company said.
The company's board will work out details and conditions of the capital increase shares, it said.
